article_content: The US debt ceiling crisis has significant implications for Canada, with many businesses relying heavily on trade with the US. This would have a devastating impact on Canada, which does a substantial amount of trade with the US. The Canadian government has expressed confidence that the US will raise the debt ceiling, but the long-term effects of the deficit gap remain a concern. Canadian business owners are advised to pay close attention to the situation and prepare for potential economic fallout.

article_content: In a remarkable display of resilience, Bruno, a 7-year-old Sable German Shepherd with the Anaheim Police Department, survived being shot in the face during a shootout. The incident occurred while Bruno was on duty with his partner, Officer RJ Young, during a probation check. When the individual being checked attempted to flee with two companions, the situation escalated, culminating in the suspect opening fire on the officer. Bruno later located one of the suspects, who fired at the dog and officers, resulting in Bruno being struck by a bullet. Following emergency surgery to remove the bullet from his lung, Bruno is expected to recover, though his return to duty remains uncertain.
